subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: What final doctor diagnosis taxonomy and recovery-order output should OpenClaw standardize for mixed LaunchAgent, runtime, RPC, service-drift, and channel-conflict states?
rationale: Current main already collects many of the facts, but the final public wording, probable-cause order, and optional structured diagnosis block are UX/product choices that should not be guessed by an automated repair.

options.title: Compose final verdict
options.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps using existing service, runtime, RPC, and channel facts.

options.title: Keep panel model
options.body: Continue improving independent doctor/gateway panels only when a live transcript proves a specific contradiction.

options.title: Define JSON first
options.body: Specify a structured diagnosis object before changing prose, then render the final doctor panel from that object.

recommendation.title: Compose final verdict
recommendation.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps using existing service, runtime, RPC, and channel facts.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest older feature-history signal across doctor orchestration, LaunchAgent repair, service entrypoint audit, and gateway restart behavior.
